Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. International Conference on AIDS in Paris finds little hope of a cure, but several effective treatments, including AZT 2. National survey by the University of Pennsylvania ranks consensual homosexual acts as a more severe crime than creating a neighborhood disturbance or smoking marijuana COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 3. Interview with Julian Schroeder, Democratic candidate for New York Congress 4. London branch of British Labour Party bans family photos from campaign literature as it unfairly promotes heterosexualism 5. Two London men charged with shocking public behavior for kissing at a bus stop 6. Andy Humm on the promotion of condoms in the media COMMERCIAL: Urban General Warehouse Sale 7. Methodist Church conference supports the protection and assistance of those with AIDS 8. Discovery of general protection for cells from the HTLVIII virus announced at the International AIDS conference in Paris 9. San Francisco, rate of transmission of AIDS has declined sharply since 1984 due to changes in sexual behavior 10. San Francisco, Sandra Day O'Connor's visit to city hall prompts protests and police brutality COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 11. Sports Report COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 12. Outreach: Conversations with GMHC: Interview with David Summers, AIDS activist with the People with AIDS Coalition 13. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This week in gay history with Jeff Bixby COMMECIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 2. Brandon Judell on Keith Clark's book "Being Sexual and Celibate" and the Meese Commission on Pornography, with clips 3. Repeat of Judell's interview with journalist and writer Michael Musto 4. Report on AIDS in the workplace COMMERCIAL: Body Mate exercise equipment 5. San Francisco Gay Pride Parade footage 6. Closing credits
